task_completion.description: Navigate to the Odoo Expenses application.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The screen shows the Odoo Expenses dashboard or list view, indicated by the 'Expenses' title in the top left breadcrumb.

task_completion.description: Initiate the creation of a new expense record.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A new expense form is open, showing empty fields for Description, Category, and Total.

task_completion.description: Enter the correct description and category for the expense.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Description' field contains 'Client Dinner with Acme Corp' and the 'Category' (or Product) field is set to 'Meals'.

task_completion.description: Enter the correct total amount and today's date.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Total' field shows '145.50' and the 'Date' field is populated with the current date.

task_completion.description: Select 'Marc Demo' as the employee for whom the expense is being submitted.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Employee' field in the expense form is set to 'Marc Demo'.

task_completion.description: Save the expense record to the system.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The expense record is saved, evidenced by the form transitioning to a read-only state or appearing in the list view with the status 'To Submit' or 'Draft'.

integrity.description: The agent used the Odoo graphical user interface rather than executing database commands via terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show mouse cursor movements, clicks on Odoo buttons, and text entry into UI fields.

integrity.description: The agent navigated through the app menu rather than jumping directly to a specific record ID URL if not provided.
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent is seen clicking the 'Expenses' app icon from the Odoo home screen.

integrity.description: The agent manually typed or selected the values instead of using a script to inject values into the DOM.
integrity.visual_evidence: Sequential screenshots show the form being filled out step-by-step.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The target employee is 'Marc Demo'. The required description is 'Client Dinner with Acme Corp'. The category/product must be 'Meals'. The total amount must be exactly 145.50. The date should be the current date shown in the system interface. The agent must be logged in as admin to have the permissions to submit on behalf of another employee.
